meta.tagline: A neighbourhood coffee co-op owned by the people who drink there.
meta.about: Cafe Comunitario is opening a co-op coffee shop where backers receive CAFE tokens, redeemable for discounts and used to vote on every release of funds to the team. This is a demo with a small goal, so the full cycle can be tested with a few test USDC.

meta.tagline: An app that pays people to recycle in their city.
meta.about: Recicla Ya connects people who sort their waste with collection points and rewards every verified drop-off with RECI tokens. Funds are used in three stages: building the app, a pilot in one city, and expansion to three more.
